press_references.value: Startup Cerebral Agrees to Pay $7 Million Fine and More Under Order by the FTC

legal_proceedings.description: Telehealth startup Cerebral agreed to a proposed FTC order resolving charges that it unlawfully shared users' sensitive health data with third parties for advertising and misled customers about cancellation, including paying $7 million in refunds and penalties and accepting restrictions on future use of health data for marketing.

press_references.value: DOJ: Cerebral unable to pay full prescribing fine

legal_proceedings.description: Cerebral has agreed to pay over $3.6 million in fines to the DOJ for unauthorized distribution of controlled substances, with an additional $2.9 million deferred due to financial conditions.

press_references.value: Virtual ADHD Providers Pivot Toward Coaching, Therapy Following Prescription Scrutiny

legal_proceedings.description: Cerebral settled a federal DOJ investigation in late 2024 for $3.6 million over allegations it pushed clinicians to prescribe controlled substances such as Adderall and Xanax for ADHD.

press_references.value: Justice Department accuses telehealth Zealthy of fraud, says remedy may bankrupt it

legal_proceedings.description: The U.S. Department of Justice and regulators pursued legal action against telehealth company Cerebral for unauthorized distribution of Adderall and making subscription cancellation difficult, resulting in a $2.9 million fine and ongoing litigation against former CEO Kyle Robertson that later extended to his new venture Zealthy.

press_references.value: In Competitive Funding Landscape, Behavioral Health Upstarts Must Outlast the ‘Walking Dead’

legal_proceedings.description: Cerebral faced public scrutiny and a Department of Justice investigation for its prescribing practices.

press_references.value: Telehealth Enforcement Is on the Rise. Transparency Will Help

legal_proceedings.description: The DOJ and FTC reached a proposed settlement with telehealth mental health provider Cerebral over alleged misuse and disclosure of sensitive health data and deceptive subscription and data security practices, requiring changed practices and about $5 million in consumer redress.

about_short_description.short_description: Cerebral is a mental health telemedicine company that is democratizing access to high quality mental health care for all.

product.name: Mental Health Telemedicine Service
product.description: An online platform providing access to licensed therapists and prescribing providers for mental health care via video chat and messaging.

product.name: Online Therapy Plans
product.description: Subscription-based online therapy sessions with licensed therapists tailored to individual mental health needs.

product.name: Medication Management Service
product.description: Remote psychiatric medication management including prescription, monitoring, and home delivery of medications.

product.name: Mental Health Educational Resources
product.description: A collection of articles and resources providing information on mental health topics and self-care strategies.

product.name: Insurance Partnership Program
product.description: Collaborations with insurance providers to offer in-network mental health services and reduce out-of-pocket costs for clients.
